# Book II: Definitions

Euclid's words on the left, the Lean that stands for them on the right. Words with no Lean partner are never used in a proof.


## Definitions

| | Euclid | Lean |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Any rectangular parallelogram is said to be contained by the two straight lines containing the right angle. | `Rectangle`; `rect A B C D`, the rectangle contained by AB, CD; `sq A B`, the square on AB |
| 2 | And in any parallelogrammic area let any one whatever of the parallelograms about its diameter with the two complements be called a gnomon. | the sum of its three parallelograms (`Parallelogram.about_diameter`) |
